action_location_sensors.title: Location sensors
action_location_sensors.description:
This is off by default. The car's position is shown on its Location map entity, and the coordinates behind it are not stored as sensors.

Turn this on and latitude, longitude, altitude and heading each become a sensor. Home Assistant records every value a sensor reports, so this builds a permanent history of where the vehicle has been - every position it reports, with a timestamp - held in Home Assistant's database until you purge or shorten the recorder history, and readable in History, in the logbook and by every Home Assistant user who can see the entities. That history is exactly what route tracking needs, but it is not something to switch on by accident.

Saving reloads the integration so the change takes effect immediately. Turning it back off later stops new values being recorded; it does not delete what is already stored - the sensors stay in the entity registry as unavailable until you remove them, and past values remain in the database until the recorder purges them.
